questions.question: To escape King Herod, an angel told Joseph to take the Child and His mother and flee. Where did they go?
An angel told Joseph that King Herod was going to search for the Child so he could worship Him. True or false?
After King Herod died, an angel told Joseph to take the Child to the land of Israel. What reason did the angel give?

answers.text: Those seeking the Child's life are dead
Egypt is no longer safe for them
The people of Israel are asking for Him

questions.question: King Herod ordered all boys in Bethlehem two years old and under put to death. What did he go by to set that age?

answers.text: The time he learned from the Magi
A word from the chief priests
